scenarios.subject: graph:/Game/UAI/Tests/WorldSpatial/BP_GraphViewFixture.EventGraph
scenarios.setup: create an owned Blueprint, open its exact EventGraph in an owned asset editor, freeze editor/graph identity and initial view
scenarios.write: set one non-default location and zoom on that exact graph view
scenarios.readback: read location and zoom from the same graph editor view after Slate settle
scenarios.cleanup: restore the captured view, close only the owned asset editor, delete the owned Blueprint

scenarios.subject: graph:/Game/UAI/Tests/WorldSpatial/BP_GraphLayoutFixture.EventGraph
scenarios.setup: create an owned Blueprint graph with two stable node identities and capture node revisions
scenarios.write: apply two explicit placements and one right_of relation through the typed layout request
scenarios.readback: read each node position and graph relation independently from the graph
scenarios.cleanup: delete the owned Blueprint without touching user asset editors

scenarios.subject: actor:/Game/UAI/Tests/WorldSpatial/WorldSpatialFixture.Subject
scenarios.setup: create an owned transient editor world with subject, anchor and surface actors; freeze their identities, bounds and revisions
scenarios.write: align and snap only the owned subject using explicit anchors, normals, surface query and expected revision
scenarios.readback: read subject transform and surface observation independently
scenarios.cleanup: destroy the owned transient world and actors

scenarios.subject: actor:/Game/UAI/Tests/WorldSpatial/WorldSpatialFixture.Subject
scenarios.setup: create one owned actor, freeze its exact identity and current revision
scenarios.write: submit one complete world transform with the matching revision through the object-transform operation
scenarios.readback: read the same actor transform independently after persistence settle and compare all ten components
scenarios.cleanup: restore and destroy only the owned actor fixture

scenarios.subject: mesh:/Game/UAI/Tests/WorldSpatial/SM_GeometryFixture
scenarios.setup: create an owned deterministic StaticMesh fixture and capture geometry hash, bounds, pivot and package revision
scenarios.write: bake one explicit transform and then update one explicit pivot with expected revisions
scenarios.readback: read geometry hash, bounds, pivot and revision independently after mesh build settle
scenarios.cleanup: delete the owned StaticMesh and its package

scenarios.subject: viewport:WorldSpatialFixtureViewport
scenarios.setup: create an owned level viewport, deterministic camera, actor and mesh hit target; freeze viewport size, camera state and observed-at
scenarios.write: select the owned actor and a real Modeling triangle from one explicit screen point and selection mode
scenarios.readback: read deprojected ray, trace hit, editor actor selection, GeometrySelectionManager element selection and pixel scale from the same explicit viewport/session binding
scenarios.cleanup: restore selection, close only the owned viewport and destroy owned world fixtures

scenarios.subject: editor:viewport-catalog
scenarios.setup: create one owned level viewport but do not place its identity in the request context
scenarios.readback: enumerate the explicit viewport registry and return stable viewport identities, types and cameras

scenarios.subject: viewport:WorldSpatialFixtureViewport
scenarios.setup: create one owned level viewport and capture its exact client identity, camera state and non-spatial session flags
scenarios.write: frame owned subjects, apply one typed camera/view/session patch, then restore the captured snapshot on the same client
scenarios.readback: read camera and flags separately from the same viewport client and query warning/view-mode/instance catalogs without mutation
scenarios.cleanup: restore the captured state and close only the owned viewport
